Cookies Policy

Last Updated: March 21, 2026

1. Introduction

This Cookies Policy explains how Wayang AI (“we,” “us,” “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website and documentation platform (collectively, the “Site”). By using our Site, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. They help website owners provide functionality, understand how their site is used, and enhance user experience.

Types of Cookies We Use:

Type Purpose Duration
Essential Cookies Required for basic site functionality Session
Performance Cookies Help us understand site usage and performance Session/Persistent
Functionality Cookies Remember your preferences and settings Persistent
Analytics Cookies Collect anonymous usage statistics Persistent

3. How We Use Cookies

We use cookies for the following purposes:

3.1 Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the Site to function properly:

  • Session Management: Maintain your session while browsing documentation
  • Security: Protect against cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks
  • Load Balancing: Distribute traffic across servers for optimal performance

Legal Basis: Legitimate interest (necessary for site operation)

3.2 Performance and Analytics Cookies

These cookies help us understand how visitors use our Site:

  • Page Views: Track which documentation pages are most visited
  • Error Monitoring: Identify technical errors and broken links
  • Performance Metrics: Measure page load times and server response
  • Search Analytics: Understand what users search for on our Site

Data Collected:

  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on pages
  • Referral source
  • Device type and browser information
  • IP address (anonymized)

Legal Basis: Your consent (where required by applicable law)

3.3 Functionality Cookies

These cookies remember your choices and preferences:

  • Language Preference: Remember your selected language
  • Theme Settings: Remember dark/light mode preferences
  • Search History: Store recent searches for your convenience
  • Collapsed/Expanded Sections: Remember navigation state

Legal Basis: Your consent

4. Specific Cookies We Use

4.1 First-Party Cookies

Cookie Name Purpose Duration Type
_session_id Maintains user session Session Essential
_csrf_token CSRF protection Session Essential
_preferred_language Remembers language choice 1 year Functionality
_theme_preference Remembers theme setting 1 year Functionality
_ga_* Google Analytics (anonymized) 2 years Analytics
_doc_search_history Stores recent searches 30 days Functionality

4.2 Third-Party Cookies

We may allow third-party services to place cookies on your device:

Service Provider Purpose Privacy Policy
Google Analytics Google Inc. Usage analytics Google Privacy
GitHub Pages GitHub Inc. Site hosting GitHub Privacy
Cloudflare Cloudflare Inc. Security and CDN Cloudflare Privacy

5. Cookie Consent

5.1 Consent Management

When you first visit our Site, you will be presented with a cookie consent banner. You can:

  • Accept All: Consent to all cookie categories
  • Reject Non-Essential: Only allow essential cookies
  • Customize: Choose which cookie categories to allow
  • Withdraw Consent: Change your preferences at any time

5.2 How to Manage Cookies

Browser Settings: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:

  • View cookies stored on your device
  • Delete individual cookies or all cookies
  • Block third-party cookies
  • Block cookies from specific sites
  • Clear cookies when you close your browser

Browser-Specific Instructions:

  • Chrome
  • Firefox
  • Safari
  • Edge

Mobile Devices:

  • iOS Safari
  • Android Chrome

6. Data Processing and Storage

6.1 Data Collected Through Cookies

The information we collect through cookies may include:

  • Device Information: IP address, browser type, operating system
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent, click patterns
  • Preference Data: Language, theme, notification settings
  • Session Data: Login status, form inputs (not passwords)

6.2 Data Retention

Cookie Category Retention Period
Essential Cookies Until end of session
Analytics Cookies 2 years (Google Analytics)
Functionality Cookies 30 days to 1 year
Preference Cookies Until manually deleted

6.3 Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data collected through cookies.

We may share anonymized, aggregated data with:

  • Service Providers: Hosting, analytics, and support vendors
  • Legal Authorities: When required by law or to protect rights

7. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

7.1 GDPR (European Union)

  • Right to Access: Request a copy of your data
  • Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate data
  • Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data
  • Right to Restriction: Limit how we use your data
  • Right to Portability: Receive your data in a portable format
  • Right to Object: Object to certain data processing
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: Change cookie preferences anytime

7.2 CCPA/CPRA (California)

  • Right to Know: What personal information is collected
  • Right to Delete: Request deletion of personal information
  • Right to Opt-Out: Opt-out of sale/sharing of personal information
  • Right to Non-Discrimination: Equal service regardless of privacy choices

7.3 Other Jurisdictions

Other regions may have additional rights under local privacy laws.

7.4 How to Exercise Your Rights

Contact us at:

  • Email: privacy@wayang.ai
  • Mail: Wayang AI, Attn: Privacy Team
  • Web Form: Privacy Request Form

We will respond to valid requests within 30 days.

8. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Cookies Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors.

8.1 Notification of Changes

When we update this policy, we will:

  • Update the “Last Updated” date
  • Post the updated policy on our Site
  • Notify users of material changes via our Site

8.2 Previous Versions

Previous versions of this policy are available upon request at privacy@wayang.ai.

9. International Data Transfers

Our Site is hosted on servers located in the United States. If you access our Site from outside the United States, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States.

9.1 Safeguards

We implement appropriate safeguards for international data transfers:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses: EU-approved contractual protections
  • Adequacy Decisions: Where applicable
  • Certification Programs: Privacy Shield Framework (where applicable)

10. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect cookie data:

  • Encryption: Data encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
  • Access Controls: Limited access to cookie data
  • Regular Audits: Periodic security assessments
  • Incident Response: Procedures for data breaches

11. Children’s Privacy

Our Site is not intended for children under 16 years of age (or 13 in certain jurisdictions). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children through cookies.

If we learn we have collected information from a child without parental consent, we will delete it promptly.

12. Do Not Track

Some browsers have a “Do Not Track” (DNT) feature. Our Site:

  • Respects DNT Signals: We honor browser DNT settings
  • No Tracking When DNT Enabled: Analytics cookies disabled when DNT is on
  • Essential Cookies Still Apply: Site functionality cookies remain active
